en.provider.availabilityThresholdDescriptio:
After available concurrency exceeds the first threshold (for example, 70%), if the multiplier of the credential currently in use is greater than this credential's multiplier, switch to this credential.
After it exceeds the second threshold (for example, 40%), if the multiplier of the credential currently in use is greater than 1.2 × this credential's multiplier, switch to this credential.
en.provider.sub2apiAvailabilityThresholdDes:

en.network.chain.help: Requests start with the current provider. A provider search failure tries each eligible row once in circular order; the successful row becomes current for later requests. Cooling rows can be selected for an immediate attempt; exhausted rows cannot. An unsupported sub-tool does not switch providers. If the full pass fails, use Browser Use.

en.provider.softInterruptDescription: Codex may append system or developer messages after the leading instruction prefix for ESC interrupts, forks, plugins, skills, and other runtime context. Some Chat Providers treat the resulting middle system message as a new prefix and lose earlier input-cache hits. When enabled, Rosetta preserves the leading system/developer prefix and sends every later system or developer message as a separate user-role message with its original content wrapped in <system>...</system>. Rosetta does not inspect or special-case turn_aborted text. Stream cancellation behavior is unchanged, and Provider caching remains best-effort. Enable this only when later instruction content is safe to deliver with user-role precedence.
en.provider.forceRosettaCompactionDescripti: For Codex compaction triggers, Rosetta sends a no-tools prompt-summary request instead of native Remote Compaction V2. The replacement mapping stores summary plaintext in SQLite for seven days. Do not enable this option unless local SQLite persistence and its filesystem protections are available.

zh.provider.softInterruptDescription: Codex 可能在开头的指令前缀之后追加 system 或 developer 消息，用于 ESC 打断、fork、插件、Skill 或其他运行时上下文。部分 Chat Provider 会把由此产生的中途 system 消息视为新的前缀，导致前文输入缓存失效。打开此选项后，Rosetta 会保留开头连续的 system/developer 前缀，并把之后每条 system 或 developer 消息改为独立的 user-role 消息，原内容用 <system>...</system> 包裹。Rosetta 不检查或单独识别 turn_aborted 文本；stream 取消行为不变，Provider 缓存仍为 best-effort。仅应在后置指令内容可以安全地以 user-role 优先级传递时启用。
zh.label.forceRosettaCompaction: 强制 Rosetta 提示词压缩
zh.provider.forceRosettaCompactionDescripti: 对于 Codex 压缩 trigger，Rosetta 会发送不含工具的提示词摘要请求，而不是 native Remote Compaction V2。replacement mapping 会在 SQLite 中以明文保存摘要七天。仅当本地 SQLite 持久化及其文件系统保护可用时启用。
